patch_description: This rewrite introduces a base + per-upload deltas scheme for RY rotations, aligned with tic-tac-toe symmetry groups (corner, edge, center). Each group shares a base angle, while three per-upload delta parameters refine the rotation for that upload. The approach increases expressivity without altering the fixed training loop, data construction, or feature map. It preserves parameter efficiency by sharing keys across wires within a group and using per-upload deltas to boost representational power without deepening the circuit. The rest of the circuit (CRY ring, CRX hub, and post-RZ blocks) remains shared per group to maintain budget. The implementation is fully contained within the EVOLVE-BLOCK, and ANSATZ_SPEC is built accordingly to enable gradient-based training with Adam.
